en.summary: Gate’s CFD Comeback Rewards (Nov 26, 2026, 09:00 – Dec 10, 2026, 09:00 UTC) is only for returning CFD traders: people who have traded CFDs before but made no CFD trades in the 7 consecutive 24-hour periods right before the start. Register with [Join Now] and trade CFDs to get 2 USDT plus tiered rewards — up to 962 USDT in USDT spot tokens per person, first come, first served while supplies last.
steps: Check that you qualify: you have traded CFDs before and made no CFD trades in the 7 consecutive 24-hour periods immediately before Nov 26, 2026, 09:00 (UTC).
Complete identity verification (KYC) on Gate — this must be done before you press [Join Now].
Between Nov 26, 2026, 09:00 and Dec 10, 2026, 09:00 (UTC) (11:00 Kyiv time), press [Join Now] on the event page to register. Only trading after registration counts.
Reach at least 120,000 USDx of cumulative CFD trading volume after registering to get 2 USDT (first 2,000 qualifying users only).

Optionally keep trading for tier rewards: 5,000,000 USDx → 10 USDT (850 spots); 30,000,000 USDx → 150 USDT (50 spots); 100,000,000 USDx → 800 USDT (5 spots). Tier rewards can be combined, up to 960 USDT.
Hit your volume before Dec 10, 2026, 09:00 (UTC). Rewards are credited automatically — there is nothing to claim.

payout.when: Automatically after you complete each task (reach the required volume), while supplies last. The rules give no exact time frame (hours or days) and no claim deadline. If a reward isn’t credited, the rules say either the rewards ran out or you don’t meet the requirements.
payout.form: USDT spot tokens, i.e. regular USDT on your spot balance: 2 USDT for Event 1; 10 / 150 / 800 USDT for the Event 2 tiers; 962 USDT maximum in total. The rules mention no lock-up and no voucher, but they also don’t spell out any withdrawal conditions.
payout.how: Credited automatically to your Gate account — no manual claim. The rules call the reward USDT spot tokens but don’t name a specific wallet section.

watch: Strict eligibility: people who have never traded CFDs don’t qualify, and neither does anyone who traded CFDs in the 7 × 24 hours before the start.
KYC must come before [Join Now]. Volume traded before you register doesn’t count.
Spots are limited and first come, first served: 2,000 / 850 / 50 / 5. You can hit the volume and still get nothing if the spots are gone.
Volume = buy volume + sell volume.

Participation and registration are temporarily unavailable in some regions; the United Kingdom is named among the restricted ones. Gate TradFi services may also be restricted in certain jurisdictions — see the User Agreement.
If you take part in other Gate events of the same type at the same time, you get rewards from only one of them.

Prohibited: multiple accounts, impersonation or fake identity documents, self-trading or wash trading (fake trades to pump volume), recycling onchain funds, coordinating to get rewards, and repeatedly transferring funds. Violations mean disqualification. Market makers, companies and institutions can’t take part.

Risk and costs: CFDs carry market volatility, leverage risk and liquidity risk. The rules don’t cover any fees or losses, and on 120,000 USDx or more of volume these can be larger than the reward. Read the CFD Service Agreement and Risk Disclosure Statement before trading.
If a translation differs from the English rules, the English version prevails.

faq.q: I’ve never traded CFDs. Can I join?
faq.a: No. The event is only for users who have traded CFDs before and then paused for at least 7 × 24 hours before the start.

faq.q: I traded CFDs a few days ago. Do I qualify?
faq.a: Not if you made any CFD trade in the 7 consecutive 24-hour periods before Nov 26, 2026, 09:00 (UTC).

faq.q: What is a CFD?
faq.a: A CFD (contract for difference) is a contract where you gain or lose on an asset’s price change without owning the asset. On Gate it sits under TradFi, i.e. traditional financial instruments, and it often involves leverage.

faq.q: How is the 120,000 USDx volume counted?
faq.a: Both buys and sells count. For example, opening a position worth about 60,000 USDx and closing it adds roughly 120,000 USDx. Only trading after you press [Join Now] counts.

faq.q: If I trade 100,000,000 USDx, do I get every tier?
faq.a: The rules say rewards from different tiers can be combined, up to 960 USDT, plus 2 USDT from Event 1. But each tier has its own limited spots, so you only get the tiers that still have spots left.

faq.q: My reward didn’t arrive. What now?
faq.a: According to the rules, an uncredited reward means it either ran out or you don’t meet the requirements. Check that you were eligible, passed KYC and pressed [Join Now] before trading.

faq.q: Is the event available in Ukraine?
faq.a: The rules only name the United Kingdom and “other restricted regions”, without a full list. Check Gate’s User Agreement; if registration on the event page isn’t available to you, your region isn’t covered.

faq.q: Что такое CFD?
faq.a: CFD (contract for difference, контракт на разницу цен) — это контракт, по которому вы зарабатываете или теряете на изменении цены актива, не владея им. На Gate он относится к разделу TradFi — традиционным финансовым инструментам, и часто торгуется с кредитным плечом.

faq.q: Награда не пришла. Что делать?
